title: Delinquency and Lien Timetable for Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreements, with Lien-Process Fees
content:
The lien timetable of a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is counted in calendar days, and the day counts and lien-process fees are set per unit class.

## Day counts from the due date of the oldest unpaid billing period

| Unit class | Overlock (day after due date) | Preliminary lien letter (day after due date) | Formal lien notice (day after due date) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | 10 | 20 | 35 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | 10 | 20 | 35 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | 10 | 20 | 35 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | 10 | 20 | 35 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | 12 | 25 | 40 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | 15 | 30 | 45 |

## Day counts after the lien notice

| Unit class | Sale advertisement (days after lien notice) | Minimum days from advertisement to sale |
|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | 15 | 10 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | 15 | 10 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | 15 | 10 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | 15 | 10 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | 15 | 14 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | 21 | 14 |

## Lien-process fees

| Unit class | Overlock fee | Lien notice fee | Sale advertisement fee | Lock cut fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | $25.00 | $45.00 | $50.00 | $35.00 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | $25.00 | $45.00 | $50.00 | $35.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | $25.00 | $45.00 | $50.00 | $35.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | $25.00 | $45.00 | $50.00 | $35.00 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | $30.00 | $55.00 | $65.00 | $35.00 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | $30.00 | $55.00 | $65.00 | $35.00 |

## Terms common to all six classes

- **Delivery of the formal lien notice:** by certified mail and email.
- **Lien-sale surplus hold:** surplus proceeds of a lien sale are held for the former tenant to claim for 365 calendar days.

## Column definitions

- **Overlock day** — the calendar day after the due date of the oldest unpaid period at which the company overlocks the unit; the overlock fee is charged when the company overlock is applied.
- **Preliminary lien letter day** — the calendar day after that due date at which the preliminary lien letter is sent.
- **Formal lien notice day** — the calendar day after that due date at which the formal lien notice may be sent; the lien notice fee is charged when it is sent.
- **Sale advertisement** — the calendar days after the lien notice date at which the lien sale may be advertised; the advertisement fee is charged when the sale is advertised.
- **Minimum days from advertisement to sale** — the calendar days after the advertisement date before the lien sale may be held.
- **Lock cut fee** — charged when the tenant lock is cut to inventory contents ahead of the lien sale.

## Reading the timetable (hypothetical)

For a Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault rental whose oldest unpaid period fell due on 1 March, day 15 after that due date is 16 March, day 30 is 31 March and day 45 is 15 April. If the lien notice is sent on 15 April, day 21 after it is 6 May, and a sale advertised on 6 May may be held from day 14 after it, 20 May.
